## Import R Packages

```{r}
pacman::p_load(sf, tidyverse, MCI, tmap, ggstatsplot)
```

## Import Data

```{r}
stores <- st_read(
  dsn = "data/geospatial",
  layer = "STORES_TC")
```

```{r}
town <- st_read(
  dsn = "data/geospatial",
  layer = "TOWN_TC")
```

```{r}
village <- st_read(
  dsn = "data/geospatial",
  layer = "VILLAGE_TC")
```

```{r}
pop2019 <- read_csv(
  "data/aspatial/pop2019.csv")

store_sales <- read_csv(
  "data/aspatial/Store_sales_data.csv")
```

```{r}
summary(store_sales)
```

## Data Preparation

### Aggregating store sales

```{r}
store_sales_aggre <- store_sales %>%
  group_by(`Store Code`) %>%
  summarise(
    "Total_Bill" = sum(Bills, na.rm = TRUE),
    "Total_Sales" = sum(Amount, na.rm = TRUE))
```

### Relational join

```{r}
stores <- stores %>%
  left_join(store_sales_aggre,
            by = join_by(
              Store_CD == `Store Code`)) %>%
  mutate(Store_size = 100)
```

```{r}
summary(stores)
```

### Tidying pop2019 data.frame

```{r}
glimpse(pop2019)
```

```{r}
glimpse(village)
```

```{r}
pop2019 <- pop2019 %>%
  mutate(V_ID = str_remove_all(
    V_ID, "-"))
```

```{r}
village <- village %>%
  left_join(pop2019,
            by = join_by(
              VILLCODE == V_ID))
```
